Monolilith is an adult yiff RTS tower defense game where the goal is to hold orgies to summon evil creatures. The Inquisition interferes with us, so we must free the victims of the Inquisition in order to recruit them into our cult. The game definitely needs to be more polished. There are some animation issues, but overall it’s quite unique. Follow Curator - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44308566-I-JUST-LOVE-NSFW-GAMES/]I JUST LOVE NSFW GAMES[/url]

It's an interesting concept, with having to station pairs of cultists near every building for them to work. It's a fun spin on RTS. Art is good, and the braided cat tail is an actually inspired character design choice. I really wish this game succeeeds. And that's why I mark review as positive, to be honest. It's quite apparent it's in early access. Questionable pathfinding, bad controls, limited variety of units, and even then some of them overlap each other in utility. There's a long way until a deserved 1.0, and I'm cheering the dev on to make it as good as they can, since it really has the potential to be special.
